meta.note: Sources were found by web search in October 2026. One-line takeaways are in our own words and based on the page that was read. Items marked as not read were listed from titles only.

sources.title: Antimicrobial resistance: report of the Director-General to WHA77 and the UNGA high-level meeting (2024)
sources.takeaway: Uses TrACSS 2023 (177 countries): 68% implement some elements of their plan, 27% have a costed and monitored plan, 11% have budget provisions; fewer than 40% have a nationwide IPC programme aligned with WHO core components; implementation and financing lag behind plan development.

sources.title: Monitoring progress on antimicrobial resistance response in the WHO African Region: insights from the TrACSS 2021. Results for the Human Health Sector
sources.authors: Gahimbare L, Mwamelo AJ, Ahmed YA, et al.
sources.journal: Journal of Public Health in Africa 14(11)
sources.takeaway: Secondary analysis of 41 countries: 85% had a plan, but only 37% had a functional multisectoral group and 32% a national system to monitor antimicrobial use; the authors call for functional One Health governance, funding and clear monitoring.

sources.title: 2025 edition of global survey to track antimicrobial resistance launches
sources.takeaway: Describes who runs the survey, the record 2024 response (186 countries) and the target of a 95% submission rate by 2030.

sources.title: Global Database for Tracking AMR Country Self-Assessment Survey (TrACSS)
sources.takeaway: Country pages with results over the years and a download of the questionnaire.
sources.note: Questionnaire itself not opened for this page.

sources.title: Kazakhstan: TrACSS 2024 trend report
sources.takeaway: Shows how one country's answers are laid out per question over time and the A to E scale; used here as the source for the question list.
sources.note: Contents not read in full; only the indicator list was extracted.
